title: profiles_tutoring_p2_test.dart E2E-721 rename sub-test silently no-ops via bare `return` instead of failing when its UI selector isn't found
why: If the ProfilePickerScreen long-press affordance is ever renamed, removed, or regressed so neither 'Edit name' nor 'Rename' text renders, execution hits this early return and the test PASSES without ever reaching lines 519-547 — the actual point of the test ('DuplicateProfileNameException -> snackbar shown; name unchanged in Drift'). No `// weaken-ok:` marker documents this bail-out per the project's own convention for intentional assertion-weakening, so a future reviewer has no signal this branch quietly exists.
recommendation: Fail loudly (`fail('rename affordance not found — check ProfilePickerScreen long-press menu')`) instead of returning silently, or resolve the ambiguity once via a stable Key/tooltip on the rename action so the ambivalent selector isn't needed at all.
acceptance_criteria: The test fails (not silently passes) when neither the 'Edit name' nor 'Rename' affordance is found.
A temporary regression check (rename the button label in source) confirms the test now fails instead of passing green.
